name: comp-546
title: Multi Image Upload Grid
description: A dashed dark container holding a three-column grid of square image thumbnails under an Uploaded Files count. Add more opens the file picker, and a round X on each photo removes it.
use: Several images go up together, such as product photos or gallery attachments.
avoid: Thumbnails are square crops, and the six-file cap with a 5MB-per-file limit are fixed in the source.
a11y: Add more and each remove button are labelled and focusable, but the drop area itself has no keyboard path. (keyboard: partial, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Four square black-and-white photos sit in a two-row grid, one column short, inside a dashed rounded frame. Above them a truncated heading reads Files (4) beside a small outlined Add more button, and each photo carries a tiny dark circle with an X at its top-right.
behaves: Dragging files over the container tints it, thumbnails fill the grid up to six, and pressing a photo's X drops it out. The recorded frames only show the finished four-photo state with the pointer drifting.
customise: The six-file cap, the 5MB limit, accepted formats and four Unsplash seed photos are written in the file; grid columns are classes to change.
weight: light: Four remote thumbnails and a hidden file input; no animation loop.
demo: Four black-and-white photos of buildings, balloons, dunes and a beach; the caption links to an API doc.
issues: The crop cuts off the start of the "Uploaded Files" heading and clips the left column.
The frames never show a photo being added or removed, only the finished grid.
The caption is developer copy ending in an API link.
polishWhy: Tidy photo grid with neat remove badges, but the clipped header and dev caption let it down.

frames.note: Crop cuts the left of the "Uploaded Files" heading and the grid's left edge.
